annotations.title: Host static website, web page: a public URL for HTML your agent made

description: Host a static web page: send HTML (up to 200,000 characters) and an optional title and get a public URL at once, valid up to 7 days; the page is sanitised (no scripts, styles, frames or forms), screened by content moderation and served with noindex. Use to hand a person a report, dashboard or summary your agent produced, or to share results between agents. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Publishes a page on the public web that stays up until it expires and cannot be withdrawn; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

days.description: Days the page stays online, 1 to 7 (default 7)

html.description: The HTML to publish (body content or a full document), up to 200,000 characters

title.description: Page title (default: the first line of text)
